verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring runs is a fair question for an API client. The evidence never documents a built-in scheduler, cron trigger or recurring collection run. The CLI runs tests on demand and can be invoked 'through an automated system', so any recurrence would come from an external scheduler such as cron or CI. That is a user-side workaround, and a one-off CLI run is not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
